notes.title: NEW DLC SOS OPS! - TRIALS
notes.content:
Hey there, SOS OPS! fans!

We’ve got some absolutely thrilling news for you – our latest DLC is here! 🎊 Say hello to **"SOS OPS! - Trials"**! Get ready to jump, dive, and zoom through our new obstacle course. This is not just any update; it’s a game-changer! 🌟

What's New? 🆕

New Location: "SOS OUT Course" 🏝️
Ever wanted to test your skills on an epic obstacle course? Now’s your chance! The new SOS OUT Course will have you navigating through tricky terrains and challenging your limits. 

New Mission: "Obstacle Course" 🏃‍♂️
Our brand new mission is here to put you through the wringer! Can you conquer the obstacles and come out on top? 

New Vehicles! 🚗
- Jet Ski: Glide through the waters with style!
- Three Wheel: For those who like a bit of balance in their ride.
- Buggy: Perfect for tackling rough terrains.

Fresh Gear! 🎩👗
- 3 New Hats 🎩
- 3 New Costumes 👗

Update Log 📝

Added:
- New Location: "SOS COM Office" – Find your way through the corporate maze.
- New Mission: "Find Figures" – Keep your eyes peeled and collect those figures!
- New Graphics Setting: "Water Quality" – Make those waves look even more stunning.
- New Vehicle Type: Water Vehicle – More aquatic fun for everyone!

Changed:
- Car Physics: Improved physics for a smoother ride. Wheels now operate in glorious 3D!
- Hub Vehicles: DLC owners, enjoy 4 new vehicles in the hub.
- Jet Ski in Downtown: Now you can jet ski in the Downtown location!
- Vehicles Handling: All vehicles now handle better than ever.
- DLC Tab: Updated in the main menu for easier access.
- Garage Environment: Revamped hub location for a sleeker look.
- Dynamic Objects: More interactable objects in Downtown and Winter Downtown.
- Fan Model: Upgraded for more realistic effects.

Fixed:
- Voice Chat: No more game breaks in restricted countries.
- Animations: Synchronized perfectly on all clients.
- Font Issues: No more wonky text!
- Localization Strings: Everything reads just right.
- Occlusion Zones: All zones now work perfectly.

We can’t wait for you to dive into this update and tackle the trials! 🚀 Download it now, and let the obstacle course adventures begin!

Stay awesome,
The SOS OPS Team 🌊

notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
Friends, February 12th is truly a legendary day 🏆

Today, we are launching the Steam Remote Play festival, introducing a new SOS OPS! level, and offering you the opportunity to get the game at an ultra-great price with a 55% discount!

But let's take it step by step. Participating in Steam Remote Play is a wonderful opportunity for us to once again introduce our game to as many players as possible, and for you to play with more like-minded gamers, find friends, and test your skills as a team player. Join us!

During the festival, we're giving you a 55% discount. The promotion will last from February 12th to February 19th. So, if you were thinking of getting SOS OPS! for yourself, your mom, dad, siblings, or grandparents, now is the time. After all, the opportunity to buy the game at such a low price doesn't come around so often 😉

Now, the most important part! We're introducing a new level, as well as a bunch of awesome updates!

Check out:

- Added positional Voice Chat
- Added new location "Amusement Park" with mission "Fix the Rides"
- Added many rides with different puzzles to fix them
- Added new skins & hats
- Added personal records for missions

Well, you can see the amount of work that has been done 💪 We highly value the feedback of all our players. Please, check out all the latest updates and, of course, share your thoughts on the main Steam game page and on our Discord server https://discord.gg/JG4Xzh89.

notes.title: Meet the new SOS OPS! mission
notes.content:
Dear friends! We promised. We delivered.

The big update is here! Meet the new SOS OPS! winter mission. It doesn’t really matter whether you managed to celebrate the winter holidays or whether you live according to your own calendar. The main thing is that it’s never too late to plunge into the festive atmosphere of magic and new adventures!

Here's what awaits you in the mission:

- completely new location
- new type of transport - snowmobiles
- new unique mechanics that diversify the gameplay
- hockey as a new mini-game
- new holiday soundtrack
- icy surfaces for sliding
- new mission starting zone “SOS Submarine”
- and much more

We hope you haven't forgotten that we have another surprise for you. Now you can purchase our game on Steam with a 51% discount! The Christmas miracle continues! So don’t slow down and rush to play the updated SOS OPS! game right now.

We hug you tightly and look forward to your feedback!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: DevLog # 1
notes.content:
Busting into Friday with exciting news. Here is our DevLog №. 1 🚀

SOS OPS! is evolving every day, and we're eager to share our achievements with players:

1. We've enhanced the underwater camera feed, so when you dive with "open eyes," it'll feel like you are in a remake of "Titanic."
2. Some wondered about the presence of a car if they couldn't get into it. Well, worry not. We've made it effortless for you to get behind the wheel.
3. Not only are "carriages" now more user-friendly, but also trains. Controlling the lever to stop the train is now more convenient.
4. The auto-centering of the camera while driving won't be bothersome with its tilts anymore. We've fixed that too.
5. By the way, you can now organize not only car races but also swimming competitions, as we've added a bit of Michael Phelps magic to the controls.
6. The revamped "Ship Repair" level will capture your hearts and make those who haven't yet acquired SOS OPS! envy you.

⚡️Most importantly, a rooster has joined the game. Wilson rooster. And dear users, it's an exclusive.

We're updating the game at a rapid pace. Exciting content awaits you!
